notes.title: FEEET IS FREE!! (soon)
notes.notes:
I am so pleased to announce that the award winning game FEEET will soon be free to play. After years of being priced at one third the price of a can of soda from a hospital vending machine, the revolutionary take on pipe puzzling and virtual noveling is at last, available to those who could buy a computer, but not a can of soda from the hospital.

Should be any day now, once steam stamps the paperwork.

Enjoy!

notes.title: A Year of FEEET
notes.notes:
One year has passed since FEEET escaped my basement and spread to [i]dozens[/i] of peoples computers! I'm a sentimental person so I wanted to make a post commemorating that. Thank you to everyone who has played FEEET! This game was a manifestation of love and we just let it turn into what it wanted to be. Anytime we get a comment or a community hub post about the game, it automatically makes the rest of my day a great day, and hearing about people enjoying the experience is the ultimate reward I can get out of this.

So once again, thanks to those who played, and thanks to those who will! Let us know what you thought about your experience!

And here is a foot to commemorate the day,
Ian Whitesel

notes.title: FEEET Development Status
notes.notes:
[h3]Hi gamers,[/h3]

The development for FEEET is finishing up, I've got a few more bolts to tighten before the game is ready. There are a few things I'd like to make known before the game comes out:

1) [b]The currently planned release date.[/b] Right now, I have my sights set on releasing on May 31st. I've had a few medical complications that stopped me from releasing sooner, plus I am a one man team at this point in development, and I have a full time job and other responsibilities. I feel pretty confident that I can meet this May 31st due date, so long as nothing physically prevents me from working (like more medical stuff, or a nuclear war).

2) [b]The currently planned price.[/b] This game is a labor of love, and I don't plan or need to make a profit off of it. I do plan on associating a price with the game (thinking about $0.99), and I really just intend on having that communicate the worth of the game, and hope it will attract more people to playing my game in the end. I'll have to look into the specifics, but I'd be open to giving copies out for free for those who email me or something, but no promises as of yet.

3) [b]The state of the game.[/b] The game has undergone a lot of visual changes, as well gameplay changes. I need to update the store page with these changes still, but I've attached some images to show some of these changes. I am hesitant to spend much time doing a new trailer for the game before I am completely finished with development, so that I don't have to do another trailer down the road.

All in all I am very excited to release this game in the coming weeks, and I hope everyone who plays has a fun time with it!
